title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Dream to Dream, One After Another

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Go!!! Buena Vistaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha… Yeah, just as I expected. What a roar. I'll turn them all into one hell of an uproar!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…! Nakayama… She's got incredible fire…! She's put everything she has into this… But…)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! I won't lose! I won't…! I'll answer everyone's feelings!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: And once again, the star of this dream race is none other than her!! Buena Vista! Buena Vista has etched her name into the history of the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! Haaah… I'm so glad…!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Whooaaa!! Nakayama was incredible too…! But Buena was even stronger…!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista!! Thank you for showing us such a wonderful dream…!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Yeah… Everyone's smiles are dazzling…! This time…)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (I've gotten closer to that breathtaking view! I answered everyone's expectations, didn't I…)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: …Now that she's done this, I can't wait to see what she'll do next…!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: She's already shown how strong she is on the Tiara campaign, and now she's won this dream race too… So what's next? Will she go after an even bigger title?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: The Autumn Tenno Sho, maybe! The ultimate showdown for middle-distance racing…! I really want her to win!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Buenaaaa!! Win the next one toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…Just a little farther, maybe? Yeah… Then if I win the next one too…)
(…will I really feel fulfilled?)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista!! Great job today!"
"We can't wait for your next race!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah… Yes…! Please keep cheering for me!
For just a moment, Buena Vista's expression seems to darken. Trusting that feeling, I start to call out to her, when…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I figured this was where I'd finally break you… but you're even tougher than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Nakayama… Thank you for today!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Your run really made me straighten up and give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I think that's why we were able to make the race so exciting. Let's run together again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll get my rematch… Though it looks like it'll have to wait a little while.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I was planning to beat you, draw everyone's attention, and then go for it… But maybe this worked out for the better.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Some unknown horsegirl winning the Arc. How about it? Gets your heart racing, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! The Arc…!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Come to think of it, everyone was expecting you to go last year, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I've been aiming for this from the start. A view from the summit that no one in Japan has ever seen before…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: An underdog horsegirl changing history… Now's the time to fulfill my promise to my teacher.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Promise…?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …It's got nothing to do with you. Stay at the top until I get back, little lady.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Nakayama's really going to challenge the Arc.
choice_data_list: Yeah. If she wins… it'll be an incredible achievement.
Yeah. If she wins… it'll be an incredible achievement.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: An incredible achievement…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Just like Spe and Vodka. A view that leaves people stunned and sends them into a frenzy…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Desire and Nakayama both have such a clear image of the view they want to see.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: With so, so many people cheering for me now… If I just keep winning, I'll be able to see that breathtaking view too, won't I?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You know… just a little while ago, I thought… just for a tiny moment, "Am I really going to be okay like this?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But that thought just blew away! I believe in it… I really do. That we can reach our dream together!
Buena Vista's expression is bright. It's still a little concerning that she felt that way, but if something comes up again, she'll surely tell me right away.
choice_data_list: If anything happens, tell me right away.
If anything happens, tell me right away.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course… I'll rely on you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. I hadn't gotten that from you yet… Thank you!
Once the post-race affairs are settled, the two of us talk briefly about her next goal in the now-quieter entrance hall.
choice_data_list: Is there any race you'd like to run?
Is there any race you'd like to run?

text_block_list.text: There'll be the usual training camp over the summer. So her next target race will most likely be in the fall.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A race I'd like to run…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Then I want to run the Autumn Tenno Sho! I heard voices calling out for me to run it.
The Autumn Tenno Sho is a G1 race where Classic and Senior horsegirls compete together. After winning the Takarazuka Kinen, it is a fitting challenge for her.
choice_data_list: All right, then. The Autumn Tenno Sho is our next goal.
All right, then. The Autumn Tenno Sho is our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: You're running more and more incredible races…!
You're running more and more incredible races…!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Really! It feels like I'm charging straight down the main course.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thanks to everyone, I've gotten to challenge so many major races… I'm really grateful.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ah…! It's Buena!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on your win!"
"We'll be cheering for you in your next race!"
"I can't wait to see you race after the summer!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you so much for cheering for me today!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll work even harder next time! So, please keep expecting great things from me!
